messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Increased 5xx rate detected on prod -> service=inference-gateway. Alerts: 5xx rate > 5% for 2m, latency p95 up 3x. Root metrics: errors=13.2% of requests last 5m.
ops-oncall-mike: I'm on it. paging note: attaching traces and top endpoints.
ops-oncall-mike: quick snapshot: /v1/generate and /v1/chat showing highest error spikes, 502/503/504 mix.
ops-oncall-mike: @ana-runtime can you join? looks like envoy at edge is returning a lot of upstream resets.
nana-runtime: joining, checking envoy stats now.
nana-runtime: grabbing /stats?filter=cluster.inference_* — seeing retries firing: retry inline attempts ~2.8x traffic. upstream_rq_5xx increased on cluster inference-backend-a.
leo-sre: any recent LB or route changes? I saw a small rollout 25m ago for route weighting.
sara-prodeng: yes there was a config push that added a retry policy for the new conversational route to improve transient failures. rollout-id: r-2026-03-15-028.
ops-oncall-mike: that matches timing. retry loops could amplify errors if upstream is flaky. first mitigation: disable retries at the edge for that route. can someone push a quick rollback?
nana-runtime: I can flip the retry policy off on the gateway route via the control plane. will do a toggled patch to set `retry_policy: none` for route `/v1/chat`.
ops-oncall-mike: please go ahead. add a short note when done.
nana-runtime: applying change now. 

```bash
# control-plane patch (one-liner)
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://control-plane.internal/api/routes/r-2026-03-15-028 \
  -d '{"route": {"path": "/v1/chat", "retry_policy": "none"}}'
```

ana-runtime: change applied, waiting for config roll through Edge proxies (~30s).
ops-oncall-mike: checking metrics — hold to update.
leo-sre: adding temporary per-route rate limit to reduce burst to backend pools: `requests_per_unit: 200` for the route.
sara-prodeng: note: the retry policy had `retry_on: 5xx, gateway-error, reset` and `num_retries: 2`. combined with client-side retries it becomes messy.
ops-oncall-mike: metrics update: 5xx dropped from 13.2% -> 6.5% in 45s. still above baseline but trending down.
beth-custsuccess: Customer-facing: we're seeing a small set of customer sessions failing with generation timeouts. estimated impacted: 4% of active users in US region. I'm preparing a status note.
leo-sre: tailing envoy logs from one edge pod shows repeated `upstream reset` then immediate retry from envoy which pushes more load: snippet: 

```text
[2026-03-15T19:12:34Z] envoy upstream reset stream: error_code=ECONNRESET cluster=inference-backend-a
[2026-03-15T19:12:34Z] router retrying request: route=/v1/chat retries=1
[2026-03-15T19:12:34Z] router retrying request: route=/v1/chat retries=2
```

leo-sre: that pattern amplifies. disabling retries should stop the cascade.
nana-runtime: control-plane confirms change propagated to 120 edge instances.
ops-oncall-mike: good. can we also temporarily move traffic weight from backend-a to backend-b (healthier pool)?
nana-runtime: doing a weights swap: backend-a -> 10%, backend-b -> 90% for cluster inference-pool. applying now.

```json
{"op":"patch","path":"/clusters/inference-pool","value":{"weights":{"backend-a":0.1,"backend-b":0.9}}}
```

nana-runtime: weight change applied.
ops-oncall-mike: metrics: 5xx now at 2.1% and p95 latency returning to normal. great.
sara-prodeng: follow-up: we should rollback the retry-policy rollout entirely and add a canary test harness for retry amplification scenarios. current patch id: r-2026-03-15-028 -> rolling back.
leo-sre: agree. also let's add an automated alert for retry amplification: if retry rate > 1.5x request rate and 5xx increases > 2% trigger.
beth-custsuccess: Status update sent to customers: small subset impacted, mitigation in progress, expected resolution within 15m.
ops-oncall-mike: handoff: I'm going to stay on post for another 30m to watch for regressions. @ana-runtime please open a follow-up ticket for root cause analysis and include call traces showing upstream resets and the retry policy diff.
nana-runtime: created ticket INF-2032 with logs, config diff, and a repro harness suggestion. link: https://internal/inf/INF-2032
leo-sre: postmortem note: probable root cause was a flaky backend instance combined with aggressive retry policy at edge. action items: 1) stricter canary for routing changes, 2) default retry_count=0 on initial rollout, 3) observability for retry amplification.
ops-oncall-mike: closing pager for now. final stats: peak errors 13.2% -> baseline 0.6% pre-incident. impacted 4% active users US for ~18m. mitigation: disabled retries + weight shift.
sara-prodeng: thanks everyone. adding a blameless RCA runbook entry. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed (severity=sev2). Summary: retry policy rollout caused retry amplification against flaky upstream; mitigations: rollback retry policy, weight shift, follow-up ticket INF-2032.
